elements.note: *** SMALLER FLOOR AREA THAN DESIGN 1 (150 vs 160 ตร.ม.) BUT MORE EXPENSIVE ON BOTH FOUNDATION TYPES. *** Render shows a more articulated single-storey roof form (double-pitched with a taller central mass) than design 1's simple hip -- consistent with a higher-spec design costing more per square metre rather than a data error.

elements.element_id: บ้านอารยสถาปัตย์ 3
elements.note: *** THIS IS THE HOUSE THIS ENTIRE 108-PAGE EXTRACTION COVERS. *** 'บ้านอารยสถาปัตย์ 3' matches the project name printed on every BOQ title block in this book (S-62047/AR-61142/SN-62034/EE-62062/M-62028), the render is the only TWO-STOREY design of the three (matching the file's own name, บ้าน_ใหญ่_2ชั้น_01 = 'big house, 2-storey'), and 210 ตร.ม. is a plausible total for the ground+upper floor areas summed across this book's A-05/A-06 room schedules.

warnings: *** THIS PAGE GIVES OFFICIAL DEPARTMENT TOTAL PRICES FOR ALL THREE STANDARD HOUSE DESIGNS, INCLUDING THIS BOOK'S HOUSE, UNDER BOTH FOUNDATION TYPES -- SOMETHING NO OTHER PAGE IN THE 108-PAGE BOOK STATES. *** Every ปร.4 BOQ sheet in this book (PNG 71-104) has every price cell blank by design (an unpriced quantity schedule for the estimator to fill in); this catalog page is the only place a finished total appears: บ้านอารยสถาปัตย์ 3 = 3,000,000 บาท on ฐานรากเข็มตอก (driven pile) or 2,745,000 บาท on ฐานรากแผ่ (spread footing).

*** THESE TOTALS CANNOT BE DERIVED FROM THIS BOOK'S BOQ SHEETS -- they almost certainly come from the department's own internal unit-price database (unrelated to this raw-JSON extraction), not from summing this book's blank ปร.4 forms. Treat them as an independent department-published reference figure, not as ground truth this extraction can reproduce or verify quantity-by-quantity.

*** THE PILE-FOUNDATION PRICE IS HIGHER THAN THE SPREAD-FOOTING PRICE FOR ALL THREE DESIGNS (by roughly 100,000-255,000 บาท), consistent with driven piles being the more expensive foundation solution -- but note this book's own structural drawings (S-02..S-10) draw ONLY the pile-foundation variant, so in practice a build from this specific drawing set would use the higher-priced ฐานรากเข็มตอก figure, not a free choice between the two.

Confirms the three-design catalog: design 1 (160 ตร.ม., 1 storey, cheapest), design 2 (150 ตร.ม., 1 storey, smaller than design 1 but MORE expensive -- a genuine non-monotonic price-vs-area relationship, most likely reflecting a more complex roof form, not a transcription error), design 3 (210 ตร.ม., 2 storeys, this book, most expensive).

*** PNG 108 (the book's final page) is a full-colour duplicate of this same catalog spread with no additional data -- a decorative back cover. *** It was NOT extracted into its own file, following the same precedent already set for PNG 01 (the book's front cover), which was also skipped as containing no unique technical or quantitative content.
No printed page number is visible on this page (unlike every numbered sheet elsewhere in the book), consistent with it being outer cover matter rather than a numbered content page.
